{{Conjecture|legends}}
This [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] '''individual''' served the [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Jerec (Inquisitor)|Jerec]] as an [[Operations officer/Legends|operations officer]] of his [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] while his forces occupied the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Ruusan/Legends|Ruusan]]. In [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]], he noticed that the [[Transport/Legends|transport]] ''[[High Hauler]]'', which had recently arrived at the planet, steered toward a restricted Class I security zone. The officer did not report it and wrote it off to the commanding officer's lack of experience, while in fact, this maneuver allowed the ship's commanding officer, lieutenant [[Alfonso Luiz Obota|Hortu Agar]]&mdash;in reality, the Rebel [[Alfonso Luiz Obota]]&mdash;to unload a ship carrying two Rebel infiltrators, [[Kyle Katarn]] and [[Jan Ors]].
